kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the two printed tables — 4 patterns (pheochromocytoma preop, the -osin first-dose rule, clonidine rebound hypertension, methyldopa pregnancy + Direct Coombs ⊕), 4 traps (phenoxybenzamine-vs-phentolamine, clonidine-urgency-vs-rebound, tamsulosin-vs-the-other--osins, mirtazapine-the-α2-BLOCKER-vs-the-α2-AGONISTS), 3 pivots.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two drug tables only; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-fork reading protocol (MOVE 1 DIRECTION: agonist at the presynaptic brake vs blocker at the receptor; MOVE 2 BAND: which drug in which printed band; MOVE 3 CELL: quote the printed cell; MOVE 4 RULES: first-dose / abrupt-cessation / pregnancy / pheo-preop) and the two-fork map connecting the α2-autoreceptor brake to this page's drug tables. The brake sentence itself is First Aid's own and prints on book 238 (the sibling topic autonomic-drugs-synapse) — carried ATTRIBUTED, cross-page; the FORK-MAP LINKAGE (agonists press the brake / mirtazapine blocks it) and the four-move protocol are KYP's design.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source page prints only the drug tables (its own title 'Sympatholytics (α2-agonists)' carries the mechanism by name only); the presynaptic-autoreceptor narrative lives on book 238 and is attributed there; the synthesis connecting brake to table, the direction-first rule, and the four moves are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (PRESS THE BRAKE, DON'T CUT THE WIRE / METHYLDOPA: THE PREGNANT BRAKE WITH THREE TAXES / PHENOXY FOREVER, PHENTOLAMINE FLEETING / -OSIN FOR THE OUTLETS, FIRST DOSE FLOORS). The source's own embedded mnemonic — the red 'p' printed in 'PTSD (prazosin)' (VLM-confirmed on the 120 DPI render) — is carried ATTRIBUTED to First Aid in the note's Table 2 caption, the -osin drug card, and the visual's band 2, and is NOT counted among the four KYP codes.

kypExtensions.summary: The pheochromocytoma preoperative-preparation miniCase (episodic headache/sweats/palpitations, elevated metanephrines, adrenal mass, surgery in three weeks — which drug before the operation), correct answer phenoxybenzamine (the printed cell 'Irreversible. Pheochromocytoma (used preoperatively) to prevent catecholamine (hypertensive) crisis.'), with distractors phentolamine (reversible — the acute rescuer, not the preop maintainer), prazosin (α1-selective with the 1st-dose orthostatic hypotension rule, printed for BPH/PTSD/HTN), and clonidine (α2-agonist — wrong direction, plus rebound hypertension with abrupt cessation).
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid prints the phenoxybenzamine cell but never builds a vignette around it; the stem, the four distractors, and the reasoning are KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The Pharmacology DrugCard section (7 cards) translating the printed table cells into drug → target → mechanism → effect → uses → adverse + clue: Clonidine/guanfacine, α-methyldopa, Tizanidine, Phenoxybenzamine, Phentolamine, the -osin family (prazosin/terazosin/doxazosin/tamsulosin with the tamsulosin exception), and Mirtazapine (α2-selective blockade — the mirror of the agonists).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints cells, not drug cards; the target/mechanism/effect/clue framing is a KYP design (uses and adverse effects are the printed cells, quoted).
